alias-of:shibah_1075>beersheba_170@18c68.note: Gen 26.33 says he called the well Shebah and the city is Beersheba. It does not say Shibah is the same place; the spelling differs.

alias-of:valley_of_gerar_1203>gerar_459@.note: The valley is named for Gerar and lies in its area (26.17, 26.19-20). Being the same place is not stated.

birth:esau_1216@e60a80.note: Twins born, Esau first; Isaac was 60 at their birth. The text gives no BC year; -1835 depends on dating outside Scripture.

birth:israel_682@e60a80.note: Jacob came out after Esau, his hand on Esau's heel. The text gives no BC year; -1835 depends on dating outside Scripture.

date:birth-of-jacob-and-esau@e60a80.note: Isaac was 40 at marriage and 60 at the twins' birth: biblical timing only. The BC year -1835 depends on dating outside Scripture.

date:death-of-abraham@ce0d91.note: Abraham lived 175 years, then died. The text gives no BC year; -1820 depends on dating outside Scripture.

date:death-of-ishmael@60d5db.note: Ishmael lived 137 years, then died. The text gives no BC year; -1772 depends on dating outside Scripture.

date:isaac-marries-rebekah@a82ffe.note: Isaac was forty when he took Rebekah to wife. Biblical timing only; the BC year -1855 depends on dating outside Scripture.

date:lifetime-of-jacob@519daf.note: Gen 47.28 says Jacob's whole life was 147 years. Born -1835 plus 147 ends about -1688, not -1655.

death:israel_682@72a729.note: Jacob yielded up the ghost (49.33) at 147 years (47.28). The BC year -1688 depends on dating outside Scripture.

died-at:isaac_616>mamre_762@b72515.note: Jacob came to Isaac at Mamre (35.27); Isaac then died (35.29), with no move stated. Gen 25.9 is about Abraham.

near:esek_409>gerar_459@149389.note: Esek was a well in the valley of Gerar, disputed by Gerar's herdmen. The word 'near' is inferred, not stated.

near:sitnah_1102>gerar_459@545c8c.note: Sitnah was another well in the same dispute with Gerar's herdmen. The word 'near' is inferred, not stated.

occurred-at:death-of-abraham>machpelah_7.note: Abraham died (25.8). The text says he was buried in Machpelah (25.9), not where he died.
